project_context.app_type: Hybrid Fullstack (Customer Booking Site + Multi-role SaaS Dashboard)
project_context.industry: Premium Event Services, Catering, Rentals, and Gifting

theme.customer_facing: Light Mode (Warm Sand/Bone White) for approachability, trust, and elegance.
theme.admin_dashboard: Dark Mode (Midnight Blue/Slate) for high-density data, focus, and premium tactical feel.

headings.rules: CRITICAL: BANNED generic sans for headings. Use Playfair Display for all major headings. Use tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) for sizes > 32px. Never exceed text-6xl for hero.

body.rules: Clean, highly legible geometric sans for all dashboard data, forms, and paragraphs. Loose line-height (`leading-relaxed`) for marketing body, tight for dashboard tables.

labels_overlines.rules: Must be Uppercase + Tiny (`text-xs`) + Wide Spacing (`tracking-[0.2em]`).

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY mixed with SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST for Admin
colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Always tint darks with blue/slate. Always explicitly set hover text color. Ensure APCA/WCAG contrast minimums.

marketing_layout.rules: Asymmetry and visual tension. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Gap: gap-8 to gap-12. Use overlapping elements. Never perfectly fill 100% of the grid.

dashboard_layout.rules: Density and data correlation. Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Gap: gap-4 or gap-6. Use 'Grid Borders (Technical Look)' with border-collapse and subtle border-border/40.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical (e.g., p-8 to p-12). Containers with borders MUST have internal padding p-6 or p-8. Ensure max-h-[80vh] on mobile hero images.

surfaces.headers: Glassmorphism (Crystal/Apple Variant): bg-white/70 or bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl, 1px delicate inner stroke, and backdrop-saturate-150.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look): Exposed skeleton, subtle bottom/right borders on grid items. Flat background, no muddy shadows.
surfaces.marketing_hero: Hero Image Overlay Max opacity: bg-black/50. If text needs contrast, use a gradient overlay, not a flat blanket. Add subtle grain/noise texture overlay to kill digital flatness.

motion.rules: Every interaction needs micro-animations. Exclude transforms from universal transitions. Use staggered entrance animations for service lists and dashboard widgets. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

components.strategy: Hybrid: Pure HTML+Tailwind for Marketing layouts. Shadcn UI heavily customized for forms, tables, and dialogs.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular based on context. Add interaction animations (scale down on active).
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Calendar. Do not use native HTML inputs. Left-align labels.
components.tables: Use Shadcn Table for Admin Dashboard. Dense spacing, hover states for rows, clear typography for financial data.
components.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn Chart components) for business analytics (revenue, orders over time). Accessible color palettes required.
components.receipt_upload: Use react-dropzone for AI OCR receipt photo upload area. Style with dashed borders and hover states.
components.toast: Use Sonner for all success/error notifications (e.g., booking confirmed, payment failed).

hero_catering.description: Luxurious table with food setup, ideal for the catering service or hero background.

service_party_org.description: Elegant party lighting and reception setup, perfect for Party Organization service.

service_gifts.description: Elegant wrapped birthday gift boxes, perfect for Birthday Gift Delivery service.

service_rentals.description: Selective focus dining table setup, ideal for Party Item Rentals.

libraries_and_tools.scrolling: lenis (Mandatory for smooth premium scrolling on marketing pages)

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Design for emotional connection first. Every page must feel emotionally directed.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. Breathing room creates a premium feel.
Do not use generic centered layouts or standard 'Bootstrap' columns. Use asymmetry and tension.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Implement micro-animations for all interactive states (hover, click, focus).
Ensure high accessibility: sufficient contrast (WCAG AA), explicit hover/focus states.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds behind text unless the image has a significant scrim/overlay.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided image URLs or search for real ones if needed.
